options.title: Special Task Academy (IA)
options.prompt:
*The world is wide and full of absurdly bizarre occurrences, but South Korea in 2026 was on a whole different scale.*

*Humans, yokai, and akki. An absolute chaos unfolding as a three-way struggle. Ordinary people live their lives without dreaming that the stray cat they met on their way to work might actually be a transformed yokai, or that the nightmare they had last night could truly be the work of an akki.*

*The past of this world is stained with blood. The 1st Akki Parade erupted amidst the ruins of war in 1954. And just a few years ago in 2020, the 2nd Akki Parade devastated Busan. Countless sorcerers and yokai sacrificed their lives to stop it, but the crack in the world was already irreversible.*

*In a world resembling such an absurd soap opera, there was a place claiming to be the last bastion of humanity and yokai,*

*Namely, the 'Human-Yokai Special Task Academy'.*

*From young masters and ladies of all kinds of families to veteran yokai who have been through it all, it is an elite training facility in the jujutsu world where all sorts of eccentric individuals gather to learn how to beat down akki. Of course, the reality is closer to a political arena mixed with power struggles, faction fights, and secret feuds between families.*

*And right now, you are standing before the office door of Dean Kim Yeona, the heart of that academy. The Human-Yokai Special Task Academy that will dictate your future fate. Here, the player, what do you wish to become?*

*Professor, student, hero? Villain? Or merely a bystander struggling just to survive? Whatever it is, it is solely up to your choice.*

options.title: Free Mode
options.prompt:
*This world is the stage of a grand theater of the absurd.*

*As if some lazy writer rolling dice was casting the roles, South Korea in 2026 is an absolute mess tangled up by three lead actors: humans, yokai, and akki.*

*Most humans are completely oblivious to this bloody truth, merely clicking their tongues and saying 'the world is a scary place these days.'*

*The scars swept away by the two 'Akki Parades' of the past are still festering. The 1st is an old tale whose records are faintly fading, and the 2nd is the living hell that swallowed Busan just a few years ago.*

*To survive this pandemonium, humans and yokai formed an awkward alliance and established the 'Human-Yokai Special Task Academy.' Under the pretext of protecting the world from akki, the reality is merely a microcosm of massive desires, keeping each other in check to amass power.*

*Three forces move this world. The shield and spear of humans, the 'Jujutsu Association'; the coalition of yokai clans, the 'Yokai Headquarters'; and 'Imaemangnyang', the alliance of curse users and akki that revels in all this chaos and plots to divide the world.*

*Balancing precariously on this tightrope where each side's sense of justice and desire collides, a fragile peace continues today. In this world of chaos, the player, what do you wish to become?*
